description: Create the complete LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py file combining the best features from all three existing pipeline files into a single cohesive Google Colab notebook script with professional CHARACTER CONSISTENCY, SCENE CONTINUITY, scripting, storyboarding, multi-character support, motion control, and voice sync.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/ms/LTX_Studio_Pipeline.py with the following cell structure:

CELL 1 - ENVIRONMENT SETUP: Replicate from LTX_PRO.py (pip installs, ComfyUI clone with pinned branches, custom nodes clone, apt packages, sys.path setup). Include all required packages: torch, torchsde, einops, diffusers, accelerate, nest_asyncio, av, spandrel, albumentations, onnx, opencv-python, onnxruntime, imageio, imageio-ffmpeg, transformers>=4.43.0, qwen-vl-utils, huggingface_hub. Clone nodes: ComfyUI_KJNodes (kj_1.2.6), ComfyUI_GGUF (ComfyUI_GGUF_22_01_2026), ComfyUI-LTXVideo, LTX2EasyPrompt-LD, LTX2-Master-Loader, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite.

CELL 2 - MODEL DOWNLOADS: Replicate the aria2c download function from LTX_PRO.py. Download: ltx-2-19b-distilled_Q4_K_M.gguf (UNet), gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors (CLIP1), ltx-2-19b-embeddings_connector_distill_bf16.safetensors (CLIP2), LTX2_video_vae_bf16.safetensors (VAE), LTX2_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors (Audio VAE), taeltx2_3.safetensors (TAE), ltx-2-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors (upscaler). Download all LoRAs: Detailer, Canny, Depth, Pose, Dolly-In, Dolly-Out, Dolly-Left, Dolly-Right, Jib-Up, Jib-Down, Static.

CELL 3 - CORE IMPORTS & UTILITIES: Include gc, re, json, time, shutil, warnings, asyncio, numpy, torch, cv2, PIL, pathlib, typing, base64, IPython.display, google.colab.files. Define: aggressive_cleanup(), _vram_free(), _vram_print(), get_value_at_index(), pil_to_tensor(), tensor_to_pil(), load_image_tensor(), get_last_frame_tensor(), display_video(), save_video_obj(), concatenate_clips(). Include ComfyUI async node loader (_load_comfy_nodes) and _audio_vae helper from LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py.

CELL 4 - CHARACTER BIBLE & CONSISTENCY SYSTEM: Implement CharacterBible class (from 12Scene) with add(), extract_from_description(), to_prompt_block(), has_characters(), names(), save(), load(). Implement VisionDescribeEngine class (from 12Scene) with MODEL_OPTIONS, PROMPT, describe() method that loads Qwen2.5-VL, describes image, unloads. Implement EasyPromptEngine class (from 12Scene) with MODELS dict, SYSTEM_PROMPT, _CLEAN_RE patterns, _load(), _unload(), _stop_ids(), _clean(), generate() method accepting character_bible parameter. Include _build_neg() negative prompt builder.

CELL 5 - SCENE SCHEMA & STORYBOARD BUILDER: Define the comprehensive JSON scene schema structure (from PRO_v2) supporting: scene_id, project_name, duration_seconds, video_style, environment (location, time, weather, mood, lighting, color_palette), main_characters (name, desc, detailed_appearance with face/hair/clothing/build/skin_tone/accessories, lora_path, personality_traits, voice_characteristics), story_action with shots array (time, camera, camera_movement, motion_intensity, action, character_focus, emotion, visual_effects), dialogue_with_timing (time, character, dialogue, english_translation, emotion, voice_direction, lip_sync_emphasis), audio (background_music, environment_sfx, voice_processing), motion_guidance (global_motion, character_motion, camera_motion). Implement build_character_prompt_detailed(), get_character_consistency_prefix(), build_shot_prompt_pro() (from PRO_v2), parse_storyboard_from_json() that auto-generates STORYBOARD list from JSON.

CELL 6 - MOTION, CAMERA & VOICE SYSTEMS: Implement CAMERA_LORA_MAPPING dict mapping movement types to LoRA filenames (dolly_forward, dolly_backward, dolly_left, dolly_right, pan_left, pan_right, tilt_up, tilt_down, zoom_in, zoom_out, static). Implement get_motion_guidance_prompt() with motion intensity descriptors. Implement get_camera_lora_for_shot(). Implement get_dialogue_for_shot_enhanced() with lip sync emphasis support. Implement build_audio_atmosphere_prompt(). Implement calculate_adaptive_strength() from PRO_v2 (adjusts based on motion_intensity change, character_focus change, previous shot success). Implement enhanced_anchor_extraction() with multi-frame candidates, brightness validation, sharpness scoring (from PRO_v2).

CELL 7 - PRODUCTION ENGINE (generate_clip + ProductionLoop): Implement generate_clip() function following the exact CLIP-first-then-UNet memory pattern from LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py's generate_clip(). Key sequence: 1) Load CLIP (DualCLIPLoader), encode text (CLIPTextEncode), create conditioning (ConditioningZeroOut + LTXVConditioning), DELETE CLIP. 2) Load UNet (UnetLoaderGGUF), apply LoRAs via LTX2MasterLoaderLD or LoraLoaderModelOnly fallback. 3) Load VAEs + upscaler. 4) Prepare latents: EmptyImage -> ResizeImageMaskNode.EXECUTE_NORMALIZED with scale_method='area' and resize_type={'resize_type':'scale by multiplier','multiplier':0.5} for half-res. For I2V: ResizeImageMaskNode.EXECUTE_NORMALIZED with resize_type={'resize_type':'scale dimensions','width':hw*2,'height':hh*2,'crop':'center'}, then LTXVPreprocess, then LTXVImgToVideoInplace. Create audio latent and concat AV. 5) Pass 1 with ManualSigmas + euler + CFGGuider + SamplerCustomAdvanced. 6) Pass 2: LTXVSeparateAVLatent, LTXVCropGuides, LTXVLatentUpsampler (2x spatial), concat with audio, second SamplerCustomAdvanced with gradient_estimation. Delete UNet after Pass 2. 7) Decode: LTXVSpatioTemporalTiledVAEDecode (with fallback to VAEDecode), LTXVAudioVAEDecode. 8) Save via CreateVideo + save_video_obj. Then implement StudioProductionEngine class that orchestrates the full pipeline: accepts scene JSON, iterates shots, uses VisionDescribeEngine for anchor analysis, EasyPromptEngine for prompt expansion with CharacterBible lock, generate_clip() for rendering, last-frame chaining between shots, adaptive anchor strength, retry logic (max 3 attempts with seed variation), progress tracking with time estimates, cache-based resume (save each clip to disk, check for existing cached clips on startup), and final concatenation via ffmpeg.

CELL 8 - CONFIGURATION & EXAMPLE SCENE: Include the full 'Whispering Cave' 12-shot storyboard from PRO_v2 as EXAMPLE_SCENE_JSON. Include all configuration parameters: PROJECT_NAME, WIDTH (848), HEIGHT (480), FPS (24), LLM_MODEL ('8B'), VISION_MODEL ('3B-fast'), CREATIVITY (0.9), USE_VISION (True), USE_TILED_VAE (True), SEED_IMAGE_PATH (None), BASE_SEED (42), OVERLAP_FRAMES (16), ANCHOR_STRENGTH_HIGH (0.85), ANCHOR_STRENGTH_LOW (0.70), USE_ADAPTIVE_STRENGTH (True), USE_CHARACTER_LORAS (True), USE_MOTION_LORAS (True), USE_VOICE_SYNC (True), GENERATE_SUBTITLES (True). Provide instructions for customization.

CELL 9 - RUN: Implement the main execution cell that: 1) Instantiates StudioProductionEngine with all config. 2) Runs the production loop on EXAMPLE_SCENE_JSON. 3) Concatenates all clips into final video. 4) Displays summary report (total shots, successful, failed, duration, output path). 5) Shows preview of final video.
